name: Clever Communications
summary: Wireless broadband carrier (ASX: APV, later CVA); founded 2001 as Access Providers; acquired Saise Telecom (2005) and Activ Australia (2006); renamed Clever Communications 19 Jul 2007; SMB assets to M2 (2010); acquired by BigAir Dec 2010/Jan 2011 (CLEVER COMMUNICATIONS AUSTRALIA PTY LIMITED, ACN 103 623 356).

events.details: Access Providers founded (Melbourne); point-to-multipoint fixed wireless carrier (ASX: APV).

events.details: Acquired by BigAir (compulsory acquisition); SMB assets to M2 (2010).

ACN note: CLEVER COMMUNICATIONS AUSTRALIA PTY LIMITED (ACN 103 623 356) is the operating private company, ABN active from 5 Feb 2003 and still registered; distinct from the ASX-listed parent Access Providers Limited (ASX:APV) that was renamed Clever Communications Australia Ltd on 19 Jul 2007 and acquired by BigAir.
The domain clever.net.au is unrelated to this company: it has no Wayback captures until 2021 (thereafter only a short redirect/parked page), long after the 2011 BigAir acquisition.
